description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationServer class, which is a core component of an OAuth2 implementation within the SuiteCRM project. It manages OAuth2 grant types, handles authorization requests, and generates access tokens, effectively enabling OAuth2 authentication flows.

classes.name: AuthorizationServer
classes.description: Handles OAuth2 authorization process including grant types, authorization requests, and token responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AuthorizationServer with repositories, keys, and optional response type.

methods.name: setEncryptionKey
methods.description: Sets the encryption key used for token encryption.

methods.name: enableGrantType
methods.description: Enables a specific OAuth2 grant type with optional access token TTL.

methods.name: completeAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Completes the authorization process and generates an HTTP response.

methods.name: respondToAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Handles token requests, generating access tokens in response.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the response type used for access tokens.
